'''Peter John Bickel''' (born 1940) is an American [[statistician]]<ref name=":0">{{cite web|url=http://orfe.princeton.edu/conferences/frontiers/Biography.pdf|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210316083006/https://orfe.princeton.edu/conferences/frontiers/Biography.pdf|archive-date=2021-03-16|title=Biography of Peter J. Bickel|work=Workshop on Frontiers of Statistics In honor of Peter Bickel's 65th birthday|publisher=Princeton University|date=May 2006}}</ref> and Professor of Statistics at the [[University of California, Berkeley]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.stat.berkeley.edu/~bickel/|title = Peter J. Bickel}}</ref> Bickel has made contributions to [[Bootstrapping (statistics)|bootstrapping]], [[robust statistics]], [[machine learning]], and other areas of statistics.<ref name=":0" />

==Education and career==
Bickel studied physics at the [[California Institute of Technology]].<ref>[https://books.google.com/books?id=W0U57b3QG18C&dq=Peter+J.+Bickel&pg=PA125 ''Reminiscences of a statistician: the company I kept''], Erich Leo Lehmann, Springer, 2007, {{isbn|978-0-387-71596-4}}</ref> He graduated from [[University of California, Berkeley]], with a Ph.D., in 1963, where he studied under [[Erich Leo Lehmann]].<ref>[https://books.google.com/books?id=qZMrkvtCU9QC ''Frontiers in statistics: dedicated to Peter John Bickel in honor of his 65th birthday''], Jianqing Fan, Hira L. Koul, Imperial College Press, 2006, {{isbn|978-1-86094-670-7}}, page 1</ref>

His students include [[C.F. Jeff Wu]], [[Jianqing Fan]], [[Katerina Kechris]], [[Elizaveta Levina]], [[Jingyi Jessica Li]], and [[Donald Andrews]].<ref>{{citation|title=Selected Works of Peter J. Bickel|volume=13|series=Selected Works in Probability and Statistics|editor1-first=Jianqing|editor1-last=Fan|editor2-first=Ya'acov|editor2-last=Ritov|editor3-first=C. F. Jeff|editor3-last=Wu|publisher=[[Springer Science+Business Media]]|year=2012|isbn=9781461455448|contribution=Ph.D. Students of Peter J. Bickel|pages=xxxi–xxxiii}}</ref>

==Personal==
He married Nancy Kramer in 1964; they have two children.<ref>[https://books.google.com/books?id=qZMrkvtCU9QC ''Frontiers in statistics: dedicated to Peter John Bickel in honor of his 65th birthday''], Jianqing Fan, Hira L. Koul, Imperial College Press, 2006, {{isbn|978-1-86094-670-7}}, page xix</ref>

*1981 the recipient of [[COPSS Presidents' Award]]<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.imstat.org/awards/copss_recipients.htm |title=COPSS Awards - Recipients |access-date=2011-05-08 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160312212858/http://imstat.org/awards/copss_recipients.htm |archive-date=2016-03-12 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
*1984 [[MacArthur Fellows Program#1984|MacArthur Fellow]]
*1986 Fellow of the [[American Academy of Arts and Sciences]]<ref name=AAAS>{{cite web|title=Book of Members, 1780–2010: Chapter B|url=http://www.amacad.org/publications/BookofMembers/ChapterB.pdf|publisher=American Academy of Arts and Sciences|access-date=June 25, 2011}}</ref>

*1986 Honorary Doctorate degree from [[Hebrew University]], Jerusalem
